C1328.title: Employees Routinely Using Personal ChatGPT for Work Fuels Shadow AI Economy
C1328.summary: An MIT report reveals that while 40% of companies subscribe to official large language model services, 90% of employees still turn to personal AI tools like ChatGPT for daily tasks. Frustrated by rigid and poorly adaptive in-house AI systems, workers are covertly adopting consumer-grade AI, creating a thriving 'shadow AI economy' largely unknown to corporate IT departments.
